pose: A massive, towering three-quarter view of the pelvic girdle.
visual_hook: The bones are thick like tree trunks. The overall shape is a huge, heavy arch designed to support 30 tons of weight.
material: Matte, light-grey tan bone. Stony and weathered.
inset_view: Top-right corner: Cross-section showing the 'Lace-bone' internal pneumaticity that kept this massive structure from being too heavy.
